## Problem

Describe the problem and link the related issue, if there is one.

## Result

Describe the behavior or documentation this change provides. Add screenshots
for a visible UI change.

## Verification

List every environment you actually tested. Include the OS name and version,
CPU architecture, Go version, build command and result, and test commands
and results. Add a row for each environment.

| OS and version | Architecture | Go version | Build command and result | Test commands and results |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| | | | | |

**Platforms not tested:**

For documentation-only changes, write "Build/tests not run: documentation-only
change". For other skipped checks, state the reason. GitHub's CI results do
not count as local testing.

- [ ] I listed the OS, architecture, and build/test results for each environment I tested.
- [ ] The change addresses one problem.
- [ ] Behavior changes have a regression test.
- [ ] Documentation and third-party notices match the change.
- [ ] Logs, screenshots and fixtures contain no private data or credentials.
